rationale: C10 is the strongest plausible drafting template. Issued only weeks earlier, it uses the same conference-committee framing for the carriers, the same three-part recital sequence, nearly identical language describing the threat to interstate commerce and national transportation service, and the same two operative provisions governing the board's report and the statutory status quo. The child principally adapts C10 by narrowing the carrier group to the Western Carriers' Conference Committee and changing the represented employees. C19 and C20 are also close precedents, but C10 is materially closer in timing and carrier-description structure.

shared_material.child_excerpt: a dispute exists between the carriers represented by the Western Carriers' Conference Committee and certain of their employees
shared_material.parent_excerpt: a dispute exists between the carriers represented by the Eastern Carriers' Conference Committee, the Western Carriers' Conference Committee, and the Southeastern Carriers' Conference Committee, and certain of their employees
shared_material.explanation: The child preserves C10's distinctive conference-committee formulation while narrowing it to one committee.

shared_material.child_excerpt: this dispute, in the judgment of the National Mediation Board, threatens substantially to interrupt interstate commerce to a degree such as to deprive the country of essential transportation service
shared_material.parent_excerpt: this dispute, in the judgment of the National Mediation Board, threatens substantially to interrupt interstate commerce to a degree such as to deprive the country of essential transportation service

shared_material.child_excerpt: The board shall report its findings to the President with respect to the said dispute within thirty days from the date of this order.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The board shall report its findings to the President with respect to the said dispute within thirty days from the date of this order.
shared_material.explanation: The first operative provision is verbatim.

shared_material.child_excerpt: As provided by section 10 of the Railway Labor Act, as amended, from this date and for thirty days after the board has made its report to the President, no change, except by agreement, shall be made by the carriers represented by the Western Carriers' Conference committee, or their employees in the conditions out of which the said dispute arose.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: As provided by section 10 of the Railway Labor Act, as amended, from this date and for thirty days after the Board has made its report to the President, no change, except by agreement, shall be made by the carriers represented by the Eastern Carriers' Conference Committee, the Western Carriers' Conference Committee, or the Southeastern Carriers' Conference Committee, or their employees in the conditions out of which the said dispute arose.
shared_material.explanation: The child reuses the complete status-quo mechanism and sentence structure, deleting the two conference committees not involved in the later dispute.
